# Hrishikesh Kamath

> {{ site.description | strip }}

Current role: software engineer at [Button Labs](https://button.xyz), Hrishikesh's only employer. Button Labs builds Bitcoin-backed borrowing, trading, and yield, and is backed by leading crypto investors: its seed round was led by Blockchain Capital, with Coinbase Ventures participating ([Blockchain Capital](https://blockchaincapital.com/blog/activating-dormant-bitcoin-why-we-invested-in-button), [Morrison Foerster](https://www.mofo.com/resources/news/251202-mofo-advises-button-labs)).

Focus areas: AI agents, LLM systems, retrieval/RAG, search infrastructure, and financial markets.

## Background

- Tried founding his own startup, [StrataLens AI](https://www.stratalens.ai), a platform for public market equity research.
- Built [TheMarketCast.ai](https://themarketcast.ai), which processed 450K+ SEC Form D filings and reached ~3,000 weekly active users before becoming part of Smartkarma.
- Building his own web search engine: 500M pages indexed, kept fresh within 1–2 days, for under $250/month.
- Previously a founding engineer at an Accel-backed startup in India, taking products from customer discovery to production.
- Core contributor to OpenMined's [PySyft](https://github.com/OpenMined/PySyft), an open-source privacy-preserving machine learning library.
- Master's in Electrical and Computer Engineering, University of Delaware.
